decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Export Development Board has conducted the Sri Lanka Expo in the years 1992, 1994, 1997 and 2012. After 14 years, it has been planned to conduct the Sri Lanka Expo from 2026 06 18 to 2026 06 21 at the Bandaranaike Memorial International Conference Hall, Colombo.  It is expected to attract 1500 exporters, export ready SMEs and buyers and investors for the same. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development to organize the Sri Lanka Expo - 2026 as a national event, was approved by the Cabinet.
